# Vishal Ojha

> One-to-one real estate brokerage across Mumbai’s western suburbs.

## What this site is

Vishal Ojha is a personal real estate broker working directly with people buying, renting, selling or leasing homes in Mumbai.

## Areas

- Bandra West: Pali Hill, Carter Road, Bandstand and the lanes between.
- Khar West: quiet lanes, old buildings and new towers next to each other.
- Santacruz West: family buildings and established societies.
- Bandra East and BKC: homes for people working in the business district, including TEN BKC and X BKC.
